messages:
jules: Heads-up — starting a staged v2 rollout in eu-west-1 in 15m. Plan: 5% -> 25% over 30m. Rollback triggers: error-rate increase >1.5x baseline for 5m OR p95 latency >450ms for 5m. Also plan to pin mobile SDK to v1 if we see UA-specific failures. /cc @matt @sre-ops

deploy-bot: schedule confirmed. rollout window at 2111112011 UTC. preflight checks passed: infra, model-variant compat, client-compat smoke.

matt: Quick note — double-check rate-limit headers. v2 increases token cost for rerank endpoints; apply rate-limit cap 50r/s per key during canary.

aya: Add header gate for X-Client-Version <= 2.0 to avoid older clients. Suggest a pinlist for mobile 1.8.x.

jules: adding header gate:

```
if (req.headers['x-client-version'].startsWith('1.')) {
  route = 'v1'
}
```

pushing config to canary.

sre-ops: FYI monitoring: dashboards updated. Alert: v2-error-rate > baseline * 1.5 -> auto-pause. Manual rollback if errors >3% absolute. Runbook: https://internal/ops/runbooks/v2-rollout

deploy-bot: canary started — 5% traffic -> v2 (eu-west-1). tokens: 2,315 reqs batched. progress updates every 5m.

pm-aaron: are release notes live? need callouts on embedding behaviour change.

jules: release notes updated in docs repo and release-notes channel.

deploy-bot: 10m update: error-rate 0.9x baseline, p95 320ms, no actions.

sre-ops: slight uptick in 3xx responses from mobile UA 1.8.x — 0.8% -> 2.1% (noticed by header filter). Recommend pinning 1.8.* to v1.

aya: done: updated pinlist `client_pins = ['mobile/1.8.*']` and rolled to edge routing. Command: `infra route update --pin 'mobile/1.8.*' --target v1`

deploy-bot: traffic adjusted: mobile/1.8.* pinned to v1. Canary continues at 12% overall.

sre-ops: monitoring shows error-rate normalized. Recommendation: continue to 25% and hold for 15m post-increase.

jules: agreed. Holding plan: 25% then wait 15m steady. If anything > triggers, rollback. Thx.
